title: New mechanical modulation method enables tunable multi-pulse fiber lasers
summary: In a study published in Optical Fiber Technology, researchers from the Changchun Institute of Optics, Fine Mechanics and Physics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences have developed a new method to control multi-pulse generation in a 1972-nm mode-locked fiber laser. By applying external mechanical modulation to the optical fiber, the researchers generated multiple adjustable pulse patterns without increasing the pump power. This offers a simpler and more flexible approach to controlling ultrafast laser output.

summary: A new survey of the sky, from the largest structures in the universe to the dust and magnetic fields in our own Milky Way, is now fully underway. Researchers at the Kavli Institute for Particle Astrophysics and Cosmology (KIPAC) at Stanford and SLAC National Accelerator Laboratory have had a hand in nearly every part of it.
